jobs.title: Service Operations Manager
jobs.location: Reading, Berkshire, Berkshire · Portsmouth · Glasgow, Renfrewshire, Renfrewshire
jobs.description: Base Location: You'll be expected to spend 50% of your working week in one of the following locations Havant, Reading or Glasgow Salary: £59,800 - £89,800 + performance-related bonus and a range of benefits to support your finances, wellbeing and family. Working Pattern: Permanent | Full Time | Flexible First options available The role The IT & OT Service Operations Manager is responsible for overseeing the seamless integration and management of IT and Operational Technology (OT) services within the organisation delivered by the IT Outsource partner. This role ensures that both IT and OT services align with the strategic objectives and operational requirements of the business, delivering optimal performance, reliability, and security to maximise availability and ensure a seamless, positive user experience. The individual will act as a key liaison between internal stakeholders and external service providers, ensuring effective governance and operational oversight of the contractual performance of the Service Integrator. You will Service Integration and Management (SIAM) : Manage the operational integration of IT and OT services to current industry standard and relevant contractual agreements, ensuring cohesive and efficient operations across both domains. Outsourced and Third-Party Collaboration: Manage relationships with outsourced service providers, SSE teams and third-party partners to ensure delivery of contracted services and adherence to SLAs. Operational Oversight : Provide operational oversight of outsourced delivery partners, ensuring compliance with service level agreements (SLAs) and key performance indicators (KPIs). Major Incident Management : Support Major Incident Management, coordinating responses to incidents and ensuring timely resolution to minimise impact on business operations. You will be part of the Service Operations Duty Manager roster and on call to provide 24/7 support. IT Service Management (ITSM): Implement and maintain IT service management processes and frameworks, ensuring best practices are followed through close collaboration with Service Strategy and Service/Process Architecture. You have Understanding of both IT and OT operational environments, including how technology performance, resilience, and availability directly affect business continuity, safety, and operational outcomes. Familiarity with recognised industry standards and best practices for service operations and incident management, supporting consistent processes, effective governance, and continual service improvement. Familiarity with outsourcing and third-party service delivery models, including working with suppliers to manage performance, clarify ownership, and maintain service quality across end-to-end operations. Proficiency in ITIL principles and service management tools, with the ability to apply structured processes to incident, problem, change, request, and service performance management. Strong incident management skills, including experience acting as a key incident commander to coordinate resolver groups, manage communications, drive timely resolution, and reduce business impact during major incidents. About SSE SSE’s purpose is to provide energy needed today while building a better world of energy for tomorrow. We do this by developing, building, operating and investing in electricity infrastructure and businesses needed in the energy transition. Our Transforming for Growth investment plan sees us investing £33bn in critical electricity infrastructure across the five years to 2030. Our Finance teams create value for all SSE business areas and play a key role in fulfilling our obligations as a FTSE100 UK-listed company. In a highly regulated and competitive environment, their experts keep us powering ahead by identifying efficiencies, providing advice and optimising our financial strategies. Flexible benefits to fit your life Enjoy discounts on private healthcare and gym memberships. Wellbeing benefits like a free online GP and 24/7 counselling service. Interest-free loans on tech and transport season tickets, or a new bike with our Cycle to Work scheme. As well as generous family entitlements such as maternity and adoption pay, and paternity leave. Work with an equal opportunity employer SSE will make any reasonable adjustments you need to ensure that your application and experience with us is positive. Please contact the company careers page / 01738 275 846 to discuss how we can support you. We're dedicated to fostering an open and inclusive workplace where people from all backgrounds can thrive. We create equal opportunities for everyone to succeed and especially welcome applications from those who may not be well represented in our workforce or industry. Ready to apply? Start your online application using the Apply Now box on this page. We only accept applications made online. We'll be in touch after the closing date to let you know if we'll be taking your application further. jobs.title: Account Manager, EMEA
jobs.description: About StarRez StarRez is the global leader in student housing software, providing innovative solutions for on and off-campus housing management, resident wellness and experience, and revenue generation. Trusted by 1,400+ clients across 25+ countries, StarRez supports more than 4 million beds annually with its user-friendly, all-in-one platform, delivering seamless experiences for students and administrators. With offices in the United States, Australia, the UK, and India, StarRez blends the robust capabilities of a global organization with the personalized care and service of a trusted partner. The Role   StarRez is seeking an Account Manager to serve as a trusted partner to our community of EMEA customers.  You will work closely with universities, PBSA operators, and student accommodation providers to understand their operational and strategic priorities, and position tailored StarRez solutions that deliver measurable value.   Your mission is twofold: work alongside our internal teams to ensure customer happiness and success and drive growth by identifying upsell opportunities aligned to their needs. This role owns the full cycle of account growth from lead generation and product demonstration to deal closure with a strong emphasis on relationship-building, consultative selling, and customer success.   You’ll collaborate closely with colleagues across Customer Success, Product, Professional Services, Renewals, and Marketing, bringing insights from the field to influence strategy and outcomes. This is an excellent opportunity for a sales-oriented problem solver who thrives on making a measurable impact and building long-term partnerships  You will own the full sales cycle within existing accounts, from identifying expansion opportunities and conducting in-depth needs analysis to leading product demonstrations, managing tender processes, and closing deals. Success in this role requires the ability to manage competing priorities, engage proactively with customers, and consistently deliver against revenue, customer engagement and data integrity targets.  This role is ideal for a sales professional who thrives in a metrics-driven environment, enjoys managing complex sales cycles, and is motivated by building long-term, commercially impactful partnerships.    Role Specifics   Work Location: Remote (UK)  Travel: Up to 50% (The percentage of travel is an estimation and may vary based on business needs.)  Reporting Structure: This role reports to the Manager, Sales.    What You Will Own   Drive revenue growth within an assigned EMEA territory and customer portfolio by identifying upsell and expansion opportunities, managing pipeline, and consistently achieving or exceeding quota targets.  Lead complex, consultative sales cycles, including in-depth discovery, tailored product demonstrations, proposal development, negotiation, and deal closure  Build and maintain trusted relationships with stakeholders across universities, PBSA operators, and student accommodation providers, developing a deep understanding of their operational needs and commercial priorities  Conduct thorough needs analysis to uncover customer challenges and align StarRez solutions to deliver measurable operational and financial outcomes  Lead and support tender, RFP, and formal procurement processes, coordinating with internal stakeholders to deliver competitive, high-quality submissions  Manage and prioritise a high volume of customer interactions and requests, effectively triaging competing demands to focus on the most impactful opportunities  Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Professional Services, Marketing, and Finance teams to scope solutions, support deal execution, and deliver seamless customer experiences  Represent the voice of the customer internally by sharing insights that inform product development, go-to-market strategy, and regional market positioning through StarRez Connect and industry events.   Maintain accurate pipeline, forecasting, and activity tracking using Salesforce, Gong, and related tools to generate data-driven insights and improve sales effectiveness  Drive customer engagement and solution adoption in a way that unlocks expansion opportunities and long-term account growth through onsite customer visits, industry event attendance and presentations.     Required Qualifications   You meet one of the following:  3+ years of experience in a quota-carrying Account Executive or Account Management role, with a proven track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets OR   5+ years of experience in student accommodation, PBSA, higher education, or multi-family property management environments, with demonstrated experience influencing purchasing decisions or managing vendor relationships  Additionally, you have:  Proven ability to operate in a metrics-driven sales environment, including pipeline management and quota attainment  Exceptional presentation and communication skills, effectively delivering clear, compelling messaging to both small stakeholder groups and large audiences across the EMEA region, with the ability to adapt style and content to diverse cultural and business contexts  Strong discovery and analytical skills, with the ability to deeply understand customer needs and translate them into tailored solutions  Excellent time management and prioritisation skills, with the ability to effectively triage multiple jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (Individual Contributor)
jobs.description: Accountabilities Own the complete post-sales customer journey, including onboarding, relationship management, and ongoing support throughout the product development and delivery process. Guide customers through complex workflows by explaining production processes, managing expectations, and ensuring alignment between customer needs and internal capabilities. Act as the main point of coordination between customers, design teams, and production or sourcing partners to keep projects progressing smoothly. Monitor account progress, identify risks and bottlenecks, and proactively resolve issues before they impact timelines or customer satisfaction. Provide consultative support during product development phases, offering guidance on specifications, materials, product feedback, and technical considerations when needed. Manage a portfolio of SMB and mid-market accounts, maintaining accurate account information, tracking milestones, and monitoring customer health metrics. Identify opportunities for account expansion, including repeat orders, new product opportunities, and additional solutions aligned with customer goals. Collect customer feedback and collaborate with internal teams to improve processes, products, and overall customer experience. Maintain strong customer relationships through clear communication, proactive engagement, and a customer-first approach. Requirements: 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, client operations, or a similar customer-facing role. Experience managing customer relationships in e-commerce, manufacturing, technology platforms, or customized product environments is highly advantageous. Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly to customers with different levels of expertise. Excellent project coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders, timelines, and priorities simultaneously. Proactive problem-solving mindset with strong attention to detail and the ability to identify and resolve operational challenges. Commercial awareness and confidence identifying growth opportunities, upselling opportunities, and solutions that create customer value. Experience using CRM platforms such as HubSpot or similar tools to manage accounts, track activities, and maintain customer records. Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment with strong ownership, organization, and accountability. Startup mindset with adaptability, urgency, resilience, and willingness to take initiative. Experience with apparel development, product manufacturing, fabric sourcing, or custom production is considered a strong advantage. Comfortable working with international teams and distributed colleagues across different time zones. Benefits: Fully remote working environment with the flexibility to work from anywhere. Opportunity to join a global team and collaborate with colleagues across multiple regions. High level of ownership and autonomy in managing customer relationships and improving processes. Direct impact on customer satisfaction, retention, and business growth. Opportunity to work with innovative systems and technology-driven workflows. Continuous learning and professional development opportunities. Inclusive and collaborative culture focused on curiosity, excellence, and customer success. Support for professional growth within a fast-paced, international environment. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best! Why Apply Through Jobgether? This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). jobs.title: Senior Account Manager - DACH
jobs.description: About the Role As our Senior Account Manager DACH, you'll own and grow a focused portfolio of our most strategic and high-value accounts across the DACH region. Working for a leading HR tech company, you'll manage inbound expansion requests, introduce customers to new products like Tellent HR and WhatsApp Hiring, and design and run your own outbound campaigns and strategic expansion initiatives to drive expansion revenue. This is a high-autonomy role for a commercially driven Senior Account Manager who takes full ownership of their results and leads by example. About the Team The DACH Account Management team consists of two Account Managers. The team owns the full expansion motion for our DACH customer base — driving upsell, cross-sell, and NRR across accounts. You'll work closely with Customer Success, Marketing, and Product. The team is ambitious, collaborative, and constantly looking for ways to improve how we work and grow together. Your 12-Month Journey First 3 months: You'll be in front of customers from week one — initially working alongside your colleagues to get up to speed on our portfolio, products, and way of working, before quickly taking full ownership of your accounts and conversations. We have a structured onboarding in place and will actively invest in helping you become successful as fast as possible. After 6 months: You're independently managing your portfolio and running your own campaigns. You've built strong relationships across your accounts, you're having impact-driven discovery conversations, and you're consistently generating pipeline. You collaborate actively with your Customer Success counterparts and are a trusted contributor in deal reviews and forecasting. After 12 months: You've run multiple self-initiated campaigns end-to-end. You're managing several complex expansion trajectories simultaneously, with a healthy pipeline and a meaningful contribution to NRR. You're a core part of the team and a key contributor to how we grow the business together. What You’ll Be Doing Own and grow a portfolio of Tellent's most strategic and high-value DACH accounts — managing both inbound expansion requests and proactive outreach to drive upsell and cross-sell Generate your own pipeline by designing and executing outbound campaigns — working closely with Marketing, RevOps, and Customer Success to bring them to life Manage expansion deals end-to-end: from opportunity identification through negotiation to close Run impact-driven discovery conversations with customer stakeholders, focused on business value and long-term growth Actively contribute to how the team evolves — bringing your own ideas, raising the commercial bar, and helping shape what great account management looks like at scale Work in close partnership with Customer Success to align on account health, timing, and expansion readiness Maintain strong pipeline discipline and CRM hygiene — accurate forecasting and clean deal documentation at every stage Share customer insights with Product, Marketing, and Leadership to contribute to go-to-market improvements What You Bring Professional fluency in German and strong English communication skills. Proven experience in Account Management within a SaaS or tech environment. A track record of independently building, managing, and closing your own pipeline with strong commercial results A proactive, entrepreneurial mindset: you don't wait to be told what to do, you take ownership and build from your own initiative Strong commercial instinct with a customer-first approach — you identify expansion opportunities while keeping the relationship and long-term value front of mind Excellent pipeline management and CRM discipline — you keep your forecast accurate and your deals well-documented Strong negotiation and relationship-building skills — comfortable in pricing conversations and value-based selling Experience in selling a suite or multi-product offering is a plus. Experience with Hubspot is a plus. What We Offer Flexible working in the Cologne area as we continue building our local team presence Diverse and international team environment €1,500 annual learning budget Pension scheme & wellness/fitness benefits Country-specific holiday policies apply Work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year Apple MacBook and all the tools you need to succeed Home office budget and allowance About Tellent Tellent is a leading Talent Management Suite designed to empower HR & People teams across the entire employee journey. Our all-in-one platform combines an Applicant Tracking System ( Tellent Recruitee ), an intuitive HRIS ( Tellent HR ), and powerful Performance Management software ( Tellent Grow ). With 250+ team members globally, 7,000+ customers in 100+ countries, and a growing ecosystem of 500+ partners, we help organizations attract, grow, and retain top talent — and we’re just getting started. AI in our recruitment process We use our internally developed AI tools to help streamline our recruitment process. However, technology never makes a decision. Every candidate is personally reviewed by our team. Your journey with us is guided by people, supported by tech. Curious about how it works? Read our AI Statement , check our Privacy Policy , or chat with us at If you require accommodations or support during the recruitment process, please let us know — we’re happy to help. jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description: Meddbase, A Cority Company is UK’s leading online EHR SaaS solution, designed for healthcare professionals seeking a secure practice management and patient record system. It includes a full suite of healthcare management software features covering consultations, cross-organization scheduling, patient analysis, document management, electronic referrals, pathology and reporting. The system also offers a user-friendly patient portal, automated email and SMS appointment reminders, and a built-in telemedicine platform with mobile app. Primary Responsibilities: Develop and cultivate relationships with existing clients, as a Cority trusted advisor. Proactively sell Cority products within your client base. Participate in/lead quarterly business reviews with your clients Identify contacts for all product lines within your client base. Work on inbound requests from clients, i.e. adding new modules, users, upgrades. Conduct product demonstrations as requested. Provide quotes, amending agreements, and services quotes as needed (with assistance from Consulting group). Work with consulting group to uncover new sales opportunities. Maintain accurate client information in Salesforce. Travel as required to develop and maintain relationships with accounts, both client and business development partners. Execute and manage program for channel/strategic partners in assigned territories. Execute market research projects as assigned. Support European sales opportunities as required, both on-site and remotely. Conduct product demonstrations as requested (Microsoft Teams/Zoom and on-site). Attend industry trade exhibitions and conferences as requested. Cority software knowledge an asset Qualifications: Must have a university degree in business or equivalent work experience. Must have at least 3 years’ experience in sales, account management or business development. Must have the ability to work independently as well as on a team. Must possess strong organization and time management skills. Must feel confident demonstrating the Cority application. Must have excellent interpersonal skills. About Us Medical Management Systems is an ISO 27001:2013 certified organization that adheres to NHS Data Security and Protection Toolkit (DSP Toolkit) standards and GDPR compliance. As part of your role, you will be required to complete annual data security awareness training and follow company policies on secure information handling. We are an equal opportunities employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability status.
